newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-AUSTRALIAN TREASURY OFFERS A$1.2 BLN OF NOTES.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-AUSTRALIAN TREASURY OFFERS A$1.2 BLN OF NOTES.

text.p: The Australian Treasury will offer a total of A$1.2 billion of Treasury notes for tender on Wednesday, the Reserve Bank of Australia said.
The tender comprises A$200 million of five-week notes, A$800 million of 13-week notes and A$200 million of 26-week notes.
The Treasury last week offered a total of A$800 million of notes, comprising A$400 million of five-week notes and A$400 million of 26-week notes.
There are A$580 million of non-official holdings of T-notes maturing in the week ending August 14.
